literal: Knowing the methods, strengthening oneself, and guarding oneself, the arrogance existing in enemies will perish.
translation: If one understands the proper methods, builds up one's own strength, and guards oneself well, the arrogance of one's enemies will vanish of its own accord.
modern: செயல்வகைகளை அறிந்து, தன்னை வலிமைப்படுத்திக் கொண்டு, தன்னைத் தற்காத்துக் கொள்ளும்போது, பகைவர்களிடம் உள்ள செருக்குத் தானே அழியும்.
explanation: This couplet outlines a strategic approach to neutralizing hostility without active warfare. First, one must analyze the situation and understand the proper course of action ('வகை அறிந்து'). Second, one must build up internal strength and resources ('தற்செய்து'). Third, one must secure one's defenses ('தற்காப்ப'). When an adversary observes such flawless preparation and self-reliance, their aggressive pride ('செருக்கு') naturally dissolves out of the realization that they cannot succeed.
